DM.Settings.HighestDrOnly.Name: Use Highest Applicable DR Only
DM.Settings.HighestDrOnly.Hint: Prevents multiple DR entries from stacking during PF1 damage application. Requires reload after changing.
DM.Settings.HighestDrOnly.ReloadNotice: PF1 Defense Manager: Reload the world for DR patch setting changes to take effect.
DM.Dialog.Delete.Title: Delete Defense Entry
DM.Dialog.Delete.Content: Delete the defense {name}? This cannot be undone.
DM.Section.Title: Granted Defenses
DM.Field.Name: Name
DM.Field.AmountHint: A number or a formula using item roll data (e.g. @class.level, @cl, 10 + @abilities.con.mod).
DM.Field.StacksHint: Adds on top of other entries of the same type
DM.Field.CritImmNote: Immune to critical hits and to precision damage (sneak attack). Precision immunity is added to the actor's Damage Immunity trait; the critical half is published for other modules to read — pf1-critical-effects marks the Critical Effect button on attack cards against this creature.
DM.Field.CiNote: Conditions this item makes the creature immune to. They are merged with every other Condition Immunity entry on the actor and written to its Condition Immunities trait, replacing whatever was entered there by hand.
DM.Field.OverrideNote: Weakens this creature's own defenses against every attack.
DM.Field.MaxHint: Only defenses this high or lower are ignored. Blank for no limit.
DM.Empty: No defenses configured. Click + to add one.
DM.Field.ChooseHint: Chosen when added to an actor
DM.Field.ChooseNote: The Damage Type above is the default pick.

DM.TempHp.Field.KeyHint: Same key doesn't stack: the higher wins. Blank uses the buff's tag.
DM.TempHp.Field.LockHint: 0 for none. A locked buff still turns on, without temp HP.
